responses.rationale: Verified both candidates against primary sources. c1 (absent-and-expected handling, question-file skip, produces_kinds pruning) is a direct application of explicit instructions already in nfr-design.md Step 2 ('never invent the content of a missing artifact', mark absent-and-expected) and Step 6 ('Referencing upstream requirement identifiers' forbids minting ids) plus the compile-time produces_kinds mechanism - no new generalizable insight. The recurring citation-pin FOLLOW-UP (confirmed in 3 of 4 units' security-design.md Review sections: boundary-three-face, advisory-retirement, revise-model-commit; applicability-arms carries an analogous NIT rather than FOLLOW-UP) is likewise not a novel pattern: nfr-design.md Step 2 already mandates 'reference an established decision as file:line' and team.md's mechanism-cite-verify-at-draft already requires file:line-verified citations. The recurrence reflects builder non-compliance with an existing explicit contract, not a missing norm. 0 learnings is correct.
